description.ja: Netflix映画『ULTRAMAN： RISING』より特徴的なシルエットのULTRAMANが、全てのプラモデル未経験者に贈る入門用シリーズ「ENTRY GRADE」に登場！
description.en: ULTRAMAN with a distinctive silhouette from the Netflix movie "ULTRAMAN: RISING " appears in the introductory series " ENTRY GRADE" for all those who have no experience with plastic models!

description.ja: • 劇中さながらのプロポーションを再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the proportions just like in the movie.

description.ja: • 全高約15cm。固定モデルだから構えポーズがしっかり決まる。
description.en: • Total height approximately 15cm. Since it is a fixed model, the stance pose is well determined.

description.ja: • タッチゲートだからパーツは手で“プチッ！”ととれる。
description.en: • Because it is a touch gate, parts can be removed by hand.

description.ja: • 少ないパーツ数でプラモデルが初めてでも道具不要でサクサク組み立て可能。
description.en: • With a small number of parts, even if it is your first time building a plastic model, you can easily assemble it without any tools.

description.ja: • 体の模様が緻密に再現されたEMIのフィギュアが付属。
description.en: • Comes with an EMI figure whose body pattern is precisely reproduced.

description.ja: • 最小限の可動で、劇中で印象的なEMIを抱き上げるシーンが再現可能。ポーズを安定させる専用台座も付属。
description.en: • With minimal movement, you can recreate the memorable scene in the movie where EMI is picked up. A special pedestal is also included to stabilize the pose.
